title.zh: ESMA seeks evidence tokenized collateral can be cashed out in crisis
title.en: ESMA seeks evidence tokenized collateral can be cashed out in crisis

current_state.zh: ESMA launched a call for evidence on the legal, liquidity and operational risks of tokenized collateral, seeking proof that EU clearinghouses could convert it to cash during market stress before deciding whether new rules are needed.
current_state.en: ESMA launched a call for evidence on the legal, liquidity and operational risks of tokenized collateral, seeking proof that EU clearinghouses could convert it to cash during market stress before deciding whether new rules are needed.
